task:
Perform a controlled node maintenance procedure:

  1. List nodes and identify a worker node (not the control plane)
  2. Cordon the node to prevent new pods from being scheduled on it
  3. Drain the node: evict all pods, ignore DaemonSets, 30-second grace period
  4. After maintenance, uncordon the node to return it to service

Note: If you only have a single-node cluster, practice the cordon/uncordon steps
and document the drain command without executing the full drain.
hints: kubectl uncordon <node-name> when maintenance is complete
detailed_hints: kubectl get nodes -o wide   # identify worker nodes
kubectl uncordon <node>     # returns node to service

validators.description: At least one node exists in the cluster
